purpose: Design rules for reading and writing document IDs, Markdown parsing and positions, heading anchors, content hash comparison values, and AI-generated fields with their validation.
summary: Frontmatter parsing and DLID recognition, issuance format, and write-only-DLID insertion with post-write verification
Markdown parsed with markdown-it-py following CommonMark; no custom regex for block structure
Reference link rules covering labels, titles, hrefs, schemes, images, autolinks and fragments
Heading anchor generation matching github-slugger rules, used only for checking and never written
Content hash is SHA-256 of the raw UTF-8 bytes, with 12-character recorded values in titles
Formal reference titles are excluded from hash calculation so recording hashes does not change the source hash
Section content hash covers the section range from heading to next same-or-higher heading
Test vectors are defined for hash invariance and sensitivity
AI-generated fields use limit L for generation and hidden threshold H for validation, with minimum array sizes
tasks: Implementing DLID reading, issuing and writing
Implementing Markdown parsing for links and headings
title: DES-008 Markdown 解析・比較値・生成情報の規則
